about.title: A locally owned Houston crew you can always reach.
text: Absolute Lawn Care and Landscaping is a team of horticulturalists, designers and maintenance specialists. We are a locally owned landscaping company serving Houston residents and businesses, and our small crew has grown into a full-service team while the commitment stayed the same: show up on time, do the job right and treat every property with care.

Our goal is to deliver high-quality landscaping with personal attention you will not find at bigger companies. You will always know who is handling your project, we are fully licensed and insured, and we make sure you can always reach us.

We have spent years learning what works in Houston's climate. We know how to handle caliche clay, treat lawns stressed by summer heat, manage drainage in flood-prone areas and choose grass types that hold up through the seasons.

Our mission is to provide the top landscaping service in the region by consistently exceeding client expectations through quality, integrity and proactive communication, and we want every outdoor space we touch, from a private backyard to a corporate campus, to stand as a testament to beauty and sustainability.

faqs.a: It depends on the size of the property, the scope and complexity of the project, the materials and plants used, and the irrigation, lighting and drainage required. We have completed projects ranging from $2,500 for basic installations to $2,000,000+ for full landscape transformations.

faqs.q: Can I customize my maintenance plan?
faqs.a: Yes. We tailor your plan to fit your lawn's needs, from mowing and trimming to seasonal fertilization, weed control and irrigation tune-ups.

faqs.q: What is included in your yearly lawn care plan?
faqs.a: Aeration, pre and post emergents, fertilization treatments, insecticides, and quarterly irrigation audits to check for leaks, adjust runtimes and keep the system efficient through the seasons.

faqs.q: What happens if it rains on my scheduled service day?
faqs.a: We will reschedule your visit as soon as possible to keep your lawn on track without damage or delay.
We inspect your irrigation system each quarter, adjusting for seasonal weather and making sure there are no leaks or wasted water.

faqs.q: Is fertilization really necessary in Houston?
faqs.a: Yes. Fertilization answers the soil nutrient deficiencies common in Houston lawns and promotes stronger, greener growth year-round.

faqs.q: Can you help redesign my entire yard?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team can create a custom landscape design based on your vision, your property layout and your plant preferences.

faqs.q: What if I only need a few updates like new plants or mulch?
faqs.a: We handle everything from full transformations to simple refreshes like mulch, rock borders, new plantings or tree trimming.
Yes. We offer financing through a trusted third-party partner, Hearth, with monthly payment plans at rates based on your credit profile. Checking your options does not affect your credit score.

faqs.q: Do you offer residential and commercial landscaping?
faqs.a: Yes. We serve both homeowners and commercial properties across the Houston area.

faqs.q: How often do you come out for maintenance?
faqs.a: Recurring maintenance clients are usually visited weekly or bi-weekly depending on the season and the plan, and fertilization and weed control are typically done quarterly or seasonally.

faqs.q: Do you offer eco-friendly lawn care options?
faqs.a: Yes. We can build a lawn care plan around environmentally conscious products and practices that are safe for your family, your pets and the surrounding environment.

faqs.q: Can you handle large residential properties?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with properties of all sizes, from small urban yards to expansive suburban lawns, and we have the equipment and the crew to manage large lawns efficiently.

faqs.q: What happens if I skip seasonal treatments?
faqs.a: Skipping seasonal treatments leaves a lawn open to weeds, pests and nutrient deficiencies, which over time means thinning grass, bare spots and higher maintenance costs.
